_readme: Official cancel or manage pages for common US subscriptions. Matched to bank descriptors by alias. Only official domains. Each URL was fetched on the date in checked; status is the HTTP code after redirects (403/429/503 = the site blocks scripted checks, the page is real). url null = no reliable link, show the how text instead.
